purpose: Test whether exact-version CC BY 4.0 arXiv full-text PDF bytes can be fetched, identity-checked and SHA-256 bound for a frozen cross-domain sample before any scientific case adjudication.

selection_rule.description: first and last source-pool row in each frozen 384-row domain block

per_item_requirements: source pool and parent binding hashes match
exact content licence is CC BY 4.0
abstract_sha256 matches the frozen abstract bytes
PDF request uses the frozen exact-version immutable_pdf_url
redirect remains HTTPS on an allowed arXiv host and preserves exact versioned identifier
response begins with PDF signature and is no larger than 64 MiB
record PDF byte count and SHA-256
